title: Correlative Confocal and Scanning Electron Microscopy of Cultured Cells
author: Casares-Arias, Alonso, et al.

steps.title: Sterilize Au‑NP coated dish
steps.instruction: Expose the Au‑nanoparticle‑coated dish to the germicide lamp in a cell‑culture hood for 15–30 min.

steps.title: Seed fluorescent MDCK cells
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of MDCK cells expressing the desired fluorescent fusion proteins (7.5 × 10⁴ cells mL⁻¹) suspended in MEM to the sterilized dish.

steps.title: Incubate cells
steps.instruction: Culture the cells for 48–72 h at 37 °C in a humidified atmosphere of 5 % CO₂, ensuring the culture remains subconfluent at the time of fixing.

steps.title: Remove liquid and add acetone
steps.instruction: On a fume hood, quickly remove most of the liquid from the dish, turn the dish upside‑down, and add several drops of acetone around the perimeter of the coverslip; incubate for 5–10 s, then wipe away any remaining acetone.

steps.title: Detach coverslip
steps.instruction: While the adhesive is softened, apply homogeneous pressure along the coverslip perimeter from the sample side by pressing the dish against a hollow cylinder whose inner diameter is slightly smaller than the inset. Alternatively, insert a scalpel between the coverslip and the plastic, gently rotate the dish to release the coverslip (use extreme care to avoid cracking).

substeps.instruction: Or use scalpel method if cylinder unavailable

steps.title: Transfer coverslip to buffer
steps.instruction: Immediately place the detached coverslip (sample side up) onto a 6‑well plate containing phosphate buffer and, if necessary, remove any residual adhesive.
